title: Peres majority upper bound
statement: For a real number $\delta$, define the Peres majority upper bound to be $\sqrt{2/\pi}\,\sqrt{1/\lfloor 1/\delta\rfloor}+4(1/\lfloor 1/\delta\rfloor)^{3/2}$, where the floor denotes the greatest natural number at most its argument, viewed as a real number in the formula.
